notes.subject: Dari … ka
notes.rationale: Hebrew uses ל…ו (to-generation-and-generation); Minang needs 'dari … ka' to carry the span

notes.subject: kasetiaan
notes.rationale: אמונתך literally 'firmness/kekok'an' of Your — rendered as kasetiaan (fidelity)

notes.subject: כוננת/ותעמד
notes.rationale: establish/stand: the verb kūn (to set upright) and ʿamad (to stand) echo each other — earth set up, earth stands

translation: Dari generasi ka generasi kasetiaan-Mu; Kau alah mambuek tagak ⟨את⟩ bumi, dan inyo tagak.
